title.rendered: Portable Office Cabins in Gurgaon: Flexible Workspace Solutions for Fast-Moving Firms

content.rendered:
Need a portable office cabin in Gurgaon? SAMAN builds flexible, well-finished office cabins for corporate teams and startups across DLF Cyber City, Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, Udyog Vihar and MG Road. Each cabin is built new and delivered ready to use.

Why Gurgaon businesses choose portable office cabins

Gurgaon's fast-moving firms often need extra workspace quickly — for a new team, a recruitment drive or a project — without committing to a long commercial lease.

  • Set up in days to match Gurgaon's fast project cycles.
  • Flexible workspace you can scale or relocate as the team changes.
  • Insulated, air-conditioning-ready interiors with good connectivity provision.
  • Lower fixed cost than leasing premium Gurgaon office space.

Where portable office cabins work in Gurgaon

  • Pop-up project and marketing offices for agencies near Cyber City.
  • Recruitment and HR drive centres for corporates on Golf Course Road.
  • On-ground project offices for developments along Sohna Road.
  • Compact head offices for startups across Gurgaon.

What a SAMAN portable office cabin includes

Every cabin is built new to your floor plan at our own plant, so you control the size, the layout and the finish. Common footprints are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used on their own or joined into multi-room layouts with private cabins, a meeting room and a washroom.

  • Structure: IS 2062 structural steel (MS) frame for strength and a long service life.
  • Walls and roof: insulated panels (around 50 mm) that keep the interior cooler in summer and cut outside noise.
  • Flooring: vitrified, ceramic or vinyl flooring chosen to suit the use.
  • Electricals: concealed wiring with switchboards, lighting, fan and air-conditioning points ready to connect.
  • Openings: powder-coated doors and windows, lockable, with optional grilles.
  • Add-ons: partitions, a pantry, a toilet, ramps, extra windows and custom branding in your colours.

Need a specific layout? Tell us how your team in Gurgaon works and we design the cabin around it — a single workspace, a reception plus cabins, or a larger multi-room office.

Delivery and installation in Gurgaon

Each cabin is manufactured at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308) and delivered to Gurgaon ready to use. Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable.

A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours and a multi-cabin layout is assembled on the spot. Tell us about access at your Gurgaon location — gate width, room for a crane and the ground condition — and we plan the placement before dispatch so installation day is straightforward.

Factory-direct, not a reseller listing

Many Gurgaon buyers start on directory and listing sites, where one enquiry is shared with several traders and the actual maker is hard to identify. With SAMAN you deal directly with the manufacturer: one point of contact, factory-direct pricing with no middle margin, a written specification, and a single team responsible for the build, delivery and after-sales support. Because we control the steel frame and the fit-out, we can tell you exactly what goes into your cabin.

What a portable office cabin costs in Gurgaon

There is no single fixed price — the cost depends on the size, the number of rooms, insulation, flooring, electricals and air-conditioning, the exterior finish and your site access.

A basic single-room cabin costs less than a fully fitted, air-conditioned multi-room layout with premium flooring and branding. Because you buy directly from the manufacturer there is no dealer margin, and we return a written, itemised quote against your exact requirement so you can see what each part adds. We do not quote a price blind — share your plan and you get real numbers.

Why buy direct from SAMAN, the manufacturer

SAMAN POS India Private Limited builds these units in-house, so a Gurgaon buyer deals with the maker rather than a reseller. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, and each cabin carries a clear warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life (the service life is an engineering estimate, not a warranty). Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation. You can see the full range, sizes and specifications on our portable office cabin range.

Why Buy Your Portable Office Cabin Factory-Direct from SAMAN

Gurgaon’s Udyog Vihar, the IMT Manesar industrial estate and the Golf Course Road / Sohna Road corridors (around PIN 122001) drive demand for site offices and security cabins. SAMAN manufactures portable office cabins in-house on an IS 2062 steel frame at its Bangalore (Gopasandra 560099) and Greater Noida (201308) units, with 500+ projects delivered. Each office cabin is built to your size with insulated wall and roof panels, vinyl or laminate flooring, doors, windows and electrical points. Delivery is Rs 3,000 with 3–5 day transit. Warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Call or WhatsApp +91 88616 22859, or send an enquiry, for a size-matched quote. Browse the full portable office range or our portable office cabin page.

FAQs: portable office cabins in Gurgaon


How quickly can I get a portable office cabin in Gurgaon?

Each cabin is built new at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308). Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable. A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours.


What sizes are available?

Common sizes are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used singly or joined into multi-room layouts with cabins, a meeting room and a washroom. We build to your floor plan.


Can the cabin be moved if our Gurgaon office relocates?

Yes — the cabin is designed to be craned and relocated, which suits firms that move between locations or districts.


How is the price decided?

Size, the number of rooms, insulation, flooring, electricals, air-conditioning, exterior finish and site access all affect the price. We quote against your exact specification — call +91 88616 22859 or use the enquiry form for a written quote.


What build quality and warranty do I get?

Each office uses an IS 2062 steel frame with insulated panels. The warranty is 5 years on the structural frame and base plus 1–2 years on finishing, and the engineered service life is 20–25 years (a service life, not a warranty).


Get a portable office cabin quote in Gurgaon

Share your size, layout and site details and we will send a written quote with lead time for Gurgaon — no obligation.

Call +91 88616 22859 or use our Send Enquiry form, and our team will help you choose the right cabin.
